What Happened (Quickly)

Eight countries showed up. Well, seven showed up. One of them, and I won't say Algeria, never played a single recorded game, which is honestly the most relatable performance of the weekend. Eighteen real games, all verified, we checked the league IDs personally after a very sharp gentleman demanded it. More on him later. He's tremendous.

Russia won. Five and one. Very quiet team. Three pings from Sandstorm all weekend, three, and they lifted the cup anyway. Some people talk, some people win, and some people, and this is rare, do neither. The USA finished second, which as everybody knows is first place with extra steps, and they played TEN games, more than anybody. Most games played. Nobody has ever played more games. Finland third, nine games, very tired, beautiful saunas waiting at home. Germany fourth with a comeback from 17,327 gold down, which the fake news said was impossible, and one game where they typed "money and bones supremacy" before the horn and then delivered on it. I respect that. That's manifesting.

Friscy (The Conductor)

Fig. 2. FriscyDriscy orchestrating the map. Every lantern on that table is a ward he placed personally. Oil on canvas, priceless, not for sale.

Now we get to the important part. People come up to me, big people, strong people, and they ask: who was really running the show out there? And I show them the numbers, because the numbers don't lie, only statisticians do.

FriscyDriscy. One hundred observer wards, second most in the entire tournament, the map was glowing, you could see it from space. 174 assists, second most, he was present at everything, like a beautiful ghost. 227 pings, third most, constant communication, his teammates never slept. 18 camps stacked, third most. Ten games played, tied for the most in the world. The man did EVERYTHING.

Everything except damage. And here's where the geniuses get confused, because in the seeding round against Ukraine he won, WON, a 43-minute game with 2,550 hero damage. That is the lowest damage in a victory in World Cup history. It's a record. It's in the official report with his name engraved on it, I put it there myself. Weak players deal damage because they have to. Friscy doesn't have to. The orchestra doesn't ask the conductor why he isn't playing the violin.

"He dealt 2,550 damage in 43 minutes and WON. You can't teach that. Frankly, you can't even explain it."

The Audit (He Reads Everything)

And one more thing, because this matters. When the first edition of the big report came out, every so-called expert just scrolled it. One man read it. Friscy looked at eighteen hundred numbers, found the ONE game that didn't belong, a fake fixture, a phantom, Germany playing a pub with civilians in it, and he called it out within minutes. The sports desk issued a correction with his name on it. Auditor of the year. Conductor of the map. Post-damage. The complete package.

Conclusion (Tremendous)

Russia has the cup for now. The USA has Friscy forever. You tell me who won.
